title: The Professor/Quotes
summary:
"You know every Amulet holds a Titan. Haven't you ever wondered about this one?"
- The Professor to the Huntik team, about the Amulet of Will (The Divine Comedy)

"Simon is still alive, buried under all these curses. If you help me, I can become him again."
- The Professor to Dante Vale (The Divine Comedy)

"I expected Eathon Lambert's son to have a few more tricks up his sleeve."
- The Professor to Sophie Casterwill (The Mission)

"I have ten times your power!"
- The Professor to Sophie Casterwill (The Mission)

"No! I must retain control of Overlos. I must have control, of everything!"

- The Professor upon Lok Lambert gaining control of Overlos (The Mission)
